title: OR11_Response_200_Orders

acceptance_decision_date.description: The date where the shop decided to accept or refuse the order. Null when the order was automatically refused or accepted.

can_cancel.description: Indicate if the order can be cancelled

can_shop_ship.description: Indicates if shops can or cannot ship orders

channel.description: The channel of the commercial's order

customer.description: Information of the customer who ordered

customer_debited_date.description: The payment's date of the order by the customer

customer_directly_pays_seller.description: True if order is paid directly to seller. False otherwise.

customer_notification_email.description: Anonymized customer email usable for notifications that do not expect an answer

discount_campaigns.description:
List of discount campaigns applied to one or more order lines in this order.
This field aggregates all unique discount campaigns present across all order lines.
Empty or absent if no discount campaigns were applied to any order line.

items.description: Discount campaign applied to one or more items within the order.

fully_refunded.description: Refunds have been requested and their cumulated amounts correspond to the sum of all remaining active order lines.

has_customer_message.description: Indicate if the customer has sent a message related to this order

has_incident.description: Indicate if order has incident on at least one order line

has_invoice.description: Is an invoice available for this order.

invoice_details.description: Invoice information linked to the order

leadtime_to_ship.description: Order's lead time to ship, in calendar days.

items.description: Custom key-value field associated with the order.
Individual product item and purchase details included in the order.

order_refunds.description:
The list of refunds aggregated by group identifier
Available when feature ‘order level tax calculation’ is enabled

items.description: Refund transaction issued against the order.

order_state.description:
Order's state

Enum: `"STAGING"`, `"WAITING_ACCEPTANCE"`, `"WAITING_DEBIT"`, `"WAITING_DEBIT_PAYMENT"`, `"SHIPPING"`, `"SHIPPED"`, `"TO_COLLECT"`, `"RECEIVED"`, `"CLOSED"`, `"REFUSED"`, `"CANCELED"`

<details>
  <summary>See deprecated values</summary>

  Deprecated values: `"WAITING_REFUND"`, `"WAITING_REFUND_PAYMENT"`
</details>

order_state_reason_code.description: Reason's code of the order state

order_state_reason_label.description: Reason's label of the order state

order_tax_mode.description:
Please note: In case there is no tax, the prices will show the same amount in TAX_EXCLUDED and TAX_INCLUDED mode. The tax mode is only useful if taxes are specified in the order.
Possible values:
  • TAX_EXCLUDED: the price fields (price, unit price, shipping price, cancellation amount, refund amount and order total prices) are expressed without tax (taxes should be added to these prices in order to get the full amount including taxes).
  • TAX_INCLUDED: the price fields include the tax amount.
Enum: `"TAX_INCLUDED"`, `"TAX_EXCLUDED"`

order_taxes.description:
Total amount of taxes aggregated per tax code and rate
Available when feature ‘order level tax calculation’ is enabled

items.description: Tax breakdown applied to the order.

paymentType.description: Warning: this field has been replaced by payment_type and will be removed soon.

payment_duration.description:
The payment's duration (i.e. the delay after which the order is supposed to be paid), in days.
Only applicable for PAY_ON_DUE_DATE orders, null otherwise.
Note that this field has currently no impact on the order workflow, it is provided for information purposes.

payment_type.description: The payment's type used by the customer to pay this order

payment_workflow.description:
The payment workflow followed by the order

Enum: `"PAY_ON_ACCEPTANCE"`, `"PAY_ON_DELIVERY"`, `"PAY_ON_DUE_DATE"`, `"PAY_ON_SHIPMENT"`, `"NO_CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION"`

price.description: Order's price (sum of order line's price)

promotions.description: Promotions' summary applied to the order

quote_id.description: Quote's id from which the order has been placed, or null if it was not from a quote

shipping_carrier_code.description: Shipping carrier code (associated with the Shipping company label)

shipping_carrier_standard_code.description: Shipping carrier standard code (associated with the shipping carrier code)

shipping_price.description: Order's shipping price (sum of order line's shipping price)

shipping_type_label.description: Label of shipping's type

shipping_zone_label.description: Label of shipping's zone

total_commission.description: Order's total commission (sum of the order line's total commission)

total_price.description: Total order's price (sum of the order's price with shipping price and fees).

description: Comprehensive details of an order including customer, line items, and fulfillment status.
